pages.text: Deep in the trial chambers the wind itself has learned to fight back. What a heavy core does to a storm can be done to one of your Breeze Servants on purpose: bind the gust to a core, feed it a spirit and it grows into a Hurricane that answers to you.

A Hurricane Servant leaps across the battlefield, hurls its fist at whoever threatens its master, calls down cyclones and lands with a smash that scatters everything nearby. Every blow it takes bursts into a gust that shoves attackers away, and arrows bounce off it. Like a Breeze Servant, it heals over time while its master wears the Wind Robe.

It is too large to be dismissed by a careless wand: the first strike only warns. When it falls it leaves a Hurricane Core behind, still carrying the storm inside and remembering its master; use it on a Breeze, or on one of your Breeze Servants, and the same Hurricane Servant takes its place. It fills four slots of an Esoteric Tesseract.
